Meta.title: Callboard
Meta.description: Plan shoot days, assign crew and gear, and keep every call time current, even when the signal on location is weak.

Landing.title: The whole shoot, on one timeline.
Landing.lede: Callboard helps small crews plan shoot days, assign people and gear, and keep call times current, even when the signal on location is weak.

sample.label: A one-day schedule with three crew lanes, a marker for the current time and one double-booked person.

Design.title: Design system
Design.intro: Every colour, size and duration in Callboard comes from a named token. This page shows them in the active theme, so changing a preference below updates everything at once.
Design.typographySample: Review tomorrow's schedule and confirm your call time.

Errors.title: This page didn't load
Errors.body: Something went wrong on our side. Your data is safe. Try again, and if it keeps happening, come back in a few minutes.
Errors.notFoundBody: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

Validation.invalid: Check this value and try again.

confirmation.mismatch: That doesn't match your email address.

department.required: Choose a department for department leads, and none for other roles.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Welcome back. Pick up where the schedule left off.

demo.title: Explore without an account
demo.intro: Sign in as one of the demo roles to see how the same organization looks to each person on the crew.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: Start planning shoot days in a few minutes.
signup.name: Your name
signup.passwordHint: Use at least {min, number} characters. A short sentence works well.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.expiredBody: Reset links work once and only for a short time. Request a new one to continue.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.signup: We sent a confirmation link to your inbox. Open it to finish creating your account.
checkEmail.recovery: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. It can take a minute to arrive.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first. The link is in the message we sent you.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too easy to guess. Try a longer one.
errors.signupDisabled: New sign-ups are turned off right now.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.confirmationFailed: That confirmation link isn't valid any more. Request a new one.
errors.demoUnavailable: Demo sign-in isn't available right now.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.lastOwner: An organization needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.soleOwner: You're the only owner. Make someone else an owner before deleting your account.
errors.demoProtected: This is a shared demo account, so this change isn't allowed.
errors.invitationInvalid: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
errors.invitationWrongAddress: This invitation was sent to a different email address than the one you're signed in with.
errors.alreadyMember: You already belong to this organization.
errors.reauthRequired: For your security, sign in again before changing your password.

RoleSummary.owner: Runs the organization: members, settings and everything else.
RoleSummary.producer: Plans productions, schedules, crew and equipment.
RoleSummary.department_lead: Edits blocks and equipment for their own department.
RoleSummary.crew: Sees assigned productions, acknowledges call times, comments and adds photos.

productions.title: Productions you can see
productions.count: {count, plural, =0 {No productions yet} one {# production} other {# productions}}
productions.empty: No productions are visible to you yet.

rbac.title: What this role can do
rbac.intro: These rules are enforced by the database as well as by the interface.

Onboarding.title: Set up your organization
Onboarding.body: An organization holds your productions, crew and equipment. You'll be its owner and can invite colleagues later.
Onboarding.name: Organization name

Denied.not-a-member: You don't belong to this organization.
Denied.role-cannot: Your role doesn't include this action.
Denied.other-department: This belongs to a different department.
Denied.not-assigned: You're not assigned to this production.
Denied.not-yours: You can only do this for your own records.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose which events create a notification for you.
notifications.mention: Someone mentions me in a comment

security.title: Password
security.intro: Choose a new password for your account.
security.demoNote: Demo accounts are shared, so their password can't be changed.

danger.title: Delete account
danger.intro: Deleting your account removes your sign-in and your membership. Comments and uploads you made stay, without your name.
danger.confirm: Type your email address to confirm: {email}
danger.demoNote: Demo accounts are shared, so they can't be deleted.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Choose a theme, an accent colour and how dense the interface feels. These apply on this device.

Members.title: Members
Members.intro: Everyone who belongs to {organization}, and what each person can do.
Members.noAccess: You can't view the member list.

remove.dialogBody: They lose access to {organization} straight away.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.intro: We don't send email from here yet. Create a link and share it yourself.
invite.linkHint: Share this link with the person you invited. It works once, for 14 days, and only with the email address you entered. You won't be able to see it again.

Invite.title: You've been invited
Invite.body: Accept to join the organization with the role set in the invitation. The invitation has to be for the email address you're signed in with.
Invite.missing: This invitation link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
